<p><strong>Today, we&#x27;re launching Skills.</strong> Teach Grok something once and it remembers across every conversation. No more repeating your preferences, formatting rules, or workflow steps.</p>

<h2 id="instant-office-documents"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#instant-office-documents">Instant Office Documents</a></h2>
<p>Need a formatted invoice, a pitch deck, or a budget spreadsheet? Grok generates production-ready Word docs, PowerPoint slides, Excel files, and PDFs, all styled and ready to share. You can also upload existing files and Grok will restructure, polish, or expand them.</p>

<h2 id="build-your-own"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#build-your-own">Build Your Own</a></h2>
<p>Creating a skill takes seconds. Describe it in conversation, upload a file, or write one from scratch. Invested time perfecting a format or workflow? Just ask Grok to save everything it learned as a skill so you never have to explain it again.</p>
<h2 id="get-started"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#get-started">Get Started</a></h2>
<p>Skills are live now on Grok 4.3 across <a href="https://grok.com">grok.com</a>, iOS, and Android.</p>
